page: Amazon Web Services i7i.4xlarge is a storage-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8559C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The configuration provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory resources consist of 128.0 GB of DDR5 RAM running at 6 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, featuring a 3750 GB NVMe SSD, while baseline network bandwidth is rated at 9 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier performance in specific single-core and text processing workloads. The Geekbench single-core score of 2308.0 and the text processing score of 2840.0 both place in the top 10% tier. Single-threaded gzip compression achieves a strong rating at 34.75 GB/sec, and the Passmark memory score of 2799.27 is in the top 25%. For machine learning workloads, the processor's Advanced Matrix Extensions support contributes to a top-tier text generation speed of 395.0 tokens/sec using a small 135M LLM model. Most other multi-core, database, and memory bandwidth benchmarks fall within the average middle 50% range.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance delivers high local storage density and modern DDR5 memory speeds relative to its resource profile, though it lacks dedicated GPU hardware. The combination of a large local NVMe SSD, 128.0 GB of RAM, and strong single-core execution makes this server appropriate for transactional databases, text processing pipelines, caching layers, and storage-intensive applications that do not require GPU acceleration.
